thig7.3:1.4: This stanza does not occur in SN 5:6.
thig7.3:3.1: This is the last line that this poem has in common with SN 5:6. The remainder of SN 5:6 reads: One who is born sees pain. It’s a binding, a flogging, a torment. That’s why one shouldn’t approve of birth. The Awakened One taught me the Dhamma —the overcoming of birth— for the abandoning of all pain, he established me in the truth. But beings who have come to form & those with a share in the formless, if they don’t discern cessation, return to becoming-again.
